card.missingTarget: This step's area is not on the screen right now; continue with Next.

welcome.title: Let's book your first appointment together
welcome.body: The quickest way to learn menton is to send an appointment request. We'll show you where to click, step by step; it takes a minute.

outline.second: Pick an academic and a time
outline.third: Write a title and description and send the request

end.body: Find a mentor in Peer Mentoring and follow all your appointments in My Appointments.
end.replayHint: You can watch the tour again from My Profile.

welcome.title: Let's answer your first mentoring request
welcome.body: With one account you can both receive and give mentoring. Let's answer a request sent to you together.

outline.second: Switch to the Give Mentoring side

end.body: You can also answer new requests from Home. Keep your availability and capacity up to date in My Mentor Profile.
end.replayHint: You can watch the tour again from My Profile.

welcome.title: Let's get ready for Office Hours
welcome.body: You are in the programme automatically. Two steps and you're ready: add your availability and answer your first request.

outline.second: Open a request in the calendar

end.body: New requests show on Home and in the My Appointments calendar. Just keep your availability up to date.
end.replayHint: You can open these tips again from My Profile.

officeHours.title: Go to Office Hours
officeHours.body: Appointment requests to academics are sent from Office Hours.

pickAcademician.title: Pick an academic
pickAcademician.body: Your advisor is at the top. There's no department limit; you can look at any academic's open hours.

pickSlot.title: Pick a day and time
pickSlot.body: Faded times are taken. The time you pick is not final until the academic approves it.
pickSlot.hint: Pick a time and click Continue

sendRequest.title: Write your topic and send
sendRequest.body: The coordinator also sees the title; only the academic sees the description.

requestSent.title: Your request was sent
requestSent.body: It shows "Awaiting approval" until the academic answers. You'll be notified when they accept or suggest a new time.

peerMentoring.title: Go to Peer Mentoring
peerMentoring.body: Everything you receive and give as a mentor is here.

giveSide.title: The Give Mentoring side
giveSide.body: This switch moves you between Get Mentoring and Give Mentoring. No second account needed.

acceptRequest.title: Accept the request
acceptRequest.body: Accepting starts the mentoring and takes one place of your capacity. If it doesn't suit you, choose Decline.

appointmentsList.title: Your appointments in one list
appointmentsList.body: The "As mentor" and "As mentee" tags show which role you have in each appointment.

addAvailability.title: Add your availability
addAvailability.body: Students can only request appointments in the hours you open.

weeklyHours.title: Add your weekly hours
weeklyHours.body: Your hours that repeat every week are here. One-off hours and days you're unavailable are on the same page.

openRequest.title: Open the incoming request
openRequest.body: Requests show in the calendar with a dashed border; they're not final until approved.

answerRequest.title: Answer the request
answerRequest.body: Accept, Decline or Suggest another time. A time you suggest is confirmed once the student accepts it.
